title: instance-registration.request
description: Registers a Coolify instance OMES may delegate to (issue #97). OMES never stores the Coolify API token itself: `credential_ref` names where the token lives (an env var, by convention the OMES_COOLIFY_TOKEN_<instance_id> shape documented in docs/coolify-adapter.md) and the generic secret-reference rule in lib/omes/py/jobs/schema.py rejects any raw scalar under a field whose name matches token/password/secret/credential/... . `base_url` must be an explicit https URL to the self-hosted or cloud Coolify API root (e.g. https://coolify.example.com/api/v1) - see https://coolify.io/docs/api/overview.
